On 2025-09-03, Pree posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her resolution message at 18:43 says Southgate cleared the backlog.
- **What I couldn't find:** There's no address or fuller site name for Southgate in anything Tobias can see. The share showed no account files to me, so I couldn't look up a depot profile. I told Tobias to ask Pree if they need more detail for the customer call.

No finance figures, outside mail or approvals were involved.
